scope: Codex self-review and observed evaluation failures; no confirmed product business defect

findings.observation: Preserved README was CRLF while fixture expected LF
findings.rootCause: Temporary Git repository inherited Windows core.autocrlf, so checkout legitimately converted baseline line endings
findings.fix: scripts/evaluation/collaboration-scenarios.mjs: set core.autocrlf=false in the disposable repository before baseline commit
findings.verification: Subsequent protocol and real diamond scenarios passed byte preservation

findings.observation: Real manager mode returned api but test expected pi
findings.rootCause: New scenario reused a legacy real-collaboration script's outdated mode expectation
findings.verification: Both complete real-provider runs passed real-manager-produced-plan

findings.observation: OpenJudge structured scoring returned HTTP 400 invalid_parameter_error
findings.rootCause: OpenAI SDK parse sent json_schema output mode, which this DashScope model rejected
findings.fix: src/evaluation/model-gateway.mjs: translate json_schema to json_object plus schema instructions; preserve SDK parsing
findings.verification: Later real scoring requests with structuredOutput=json_schema completed with HTTP 200 and parsed scores

findings.observation: An uncaught semantic provider exception prevented hard results from being written to scores.json
findings.rootCause: Initial evaluator handled GraderError results but not exceptions raised by LLMGrader.aevaluate
findings.fix: scripts/evaluation/openjudge/evaluate.py: catch errors per semantic case, retain hard verdicts, return grader_error and nonzero exit
findings.verification: test/agent-evaluation.test.mjs: actual connection failure retained hardStatus=pass, semanticStatus=grader_error and score=null

findings.observation: Self-review found normalized task dependencies absent despite session dependency edges existing
findings.rootCause: Initial collector read task.depends_on, while current coordinator exposes session.dependencies rows
findings.fix: src/evaluation/evidence.mjs: map dependency edges by task_id and depends_on_id
findings.verification: New mapping regression and final case-summary.json retain all diamond DAG edges

findings.observation: A 4/5 tool-selection explanation incorrectly suggested run_check did not execute the requested Node command
findings.rootCause: Initial grader input omitted the host's approved verification contract linking run_check(unit) to Node check.cjs
findings.fix: Export source verification-contract event IDs/runtime/check args and supply them to tool-selection grading
findings.verification: semantic-recheck.json retained 4/5 but correctly recognized actual execution; final fresh batch scored 5/5
findings.remainingLimitation: Semantic scores vary across runs and lack human calibration; keep diagnostic-only and never override objective verification

findings.observation: Final self-review found that not_run records could generate failure findings from their underlying false/unknown fields
findings.rootCause: Finding generation filtered assertions without respecting the case not_run state
findings.fix: src/evaluation/evidence.mjs: return no business findings for not_run cases
findings.verification: Targeted hard-evidence and redaction tests passed 2/2, including normalization of an unexecuted task; existing executed pass cases are unchanged

findings.observation: A fresh standard venv/pip install using the local default mirror could not find openai==3.42.1
findings.rootCause: Local default pip index mirror lacked the locked release that the resolver obtained from official PyPI
findings.fix: Use explicit https://pypi.org/simple in CI and documented pip installation, preserving locked versions
findings.verification: See installation-check.json for the actual official-index installation and evaluation checks
